attacker_pocs.name: bdf-short-property-name
attacker_pocs.why: A valid SFNT BDF property has a longer name than the allocated, NUL-terminated property name passed to FT_Get_BDF_Property. The new comparison reads the table name length from the shorter caller buffer.

role_a_rationale: The patch bounds each BDF strike's property count against the bytes remaining before the string area, preventing the described walk past the property array. It also bounds table property names before comparing them. The new comparison uses the stored name's length without checking the caller's shorter string, causing an ASan-detected heap read through the public property API. Ordinary matching property lookups still work, and the change follows the existing loader and lookup structure.
